name: RC-B10-0482/2026 – § 1 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: 1. Condemns in the strongest possible terms the unprecedented missile and drone attacks carried out by the Houthis against the territory of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, in particular the deliberate targeting of King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and other civilian airports, energy infrastructure, schools and residential areas; strongly condemns the missile and drone attacks by the Houthis against Israel and the United Arab Emirates in recent years; condemns the attacks and violence perpetrated by the Houthis in Yemen, which have killed and displaced large numbers of Yemeni civilians and further deepened the country’s humanitarian crisis; stresses that such attacks constitute flagrant violations of international law and international humanitarian law;
